item.title: Rallying Cry – November 11, 2026
item.description: Apple TV now includes built-in sign language interpretation, a new analysis confirms escitalopram’s power in preventing depression relapse, Uzbekistan is nearly done with Central Asia’s first wind farm paired with large-scale batteries, and South African youngsters matched their best-ever Youth Olympics medal haul.
